newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gold shares reverse most losses at close.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gold shares reverse most losses at close.

text.p: South African shares ended firmer in quiet trade on Thursday, boosted by a firm Dow Jones overnight. Golds retraced most morning losses and ended slighlty weaker.

Dealers said U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comments on Wednesday were well received by investors. However, a host of profit warnings from companies including Housewares, Plessey, Sappi and Polifin have dampened sentiment in the market, dealers said.
But local institutions have been buyers at low levels, they said. "Local institutions still see value in industrial equities. They have been buyers at low levels," one said.
Gold shares bounced back after lunch as investors started buying on perception that the gold price had reached bottom.
The overall index ended up 13.8 points to 7,084.2 points, industrials add 29.2 points to 8,278.0 and golds off 2.6 points to 1,430.1.
